name: Pentagram
philosophy: Partner-led, independently owned consultancy where the owners make the work; every identity is one idea stated in a sentence and executed relentlessly across every touchpoint with minimal decoration.

type.notes: Studio voice is a single grotesk in sentence case, titles at ~3.6% of width with -0.02em tracking. Client work uses custom or customised faces; display type is often uppercase stacks where every line is sized to fill the same measure (playbill logic); small uppercase titling tracked +0.15em.

palette: One signature colour against neutrals (red-orange on black/paper white for Folger, black on warm off-white with a yellow accent for Guggenheim); occasionally a deliberate multi-colour system (NHM three-colour sunburst on aubergine/dark grounds). Site frame is white with charcoal #222 sections.
imagery: Architectural in-situ photography of signage in stone, concrete and steel; flat graphic slides of the mark on a solid ground; short motion loops; merchandise shot as tight 2x2 grids with no gutters.
presentation: Heritage/context photography pair (one tall + two stacked)
signatures: A single initial cropped huge becomes the whole symbol
Uppercase type stacks where every line fills one measure
Wordmark set between hairline rules that run through it
One colour + black/off-white, nothing else
Large-text pull quote starting at the 50% column
Merch shown as a 2x2 grid with no gutters
Generative symbol (rings/ripples) with four named motion behaviours

projects.what: Red-orange 'F' isolated from custom Puck Headline; playbill type stacks; faceted silver entrance lettering and garden inscriptions.
NHM ripple sunburst and Word Rings from a code-based generator, four motion routes, NHM Wallop; banners, posters, tote, tee.
Single-tier system for four museums: G symbol, Guggenheim Sans, constellation architecture, modular layouts, merch.

layouts.name: Initial-as-Symbol Hero
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9, ground #000. Draw the brand's first letter in the heaviest available display face, glyph height = 66% of canvas height, top at 17%, left edge at 44% of width, fill = brand colour (default #E8380D). Wordmark: full name in a light humanist sans, uppercase, tracking +0.04em, cap height 4.2% of canvas height, three lines (split on spaces; if one word, split by syllable) left-aligned at x=29%, block bottom at y=67%, line gap 2.4% of height. Place a 0.25%-of-height hairline rule (off-white #F4EFE6) above the second and third lines, spanning exactly the longest line's width. Text colour #F4EFE6, allowed to overprint the giant letter. Nothing else on canvas. Pentagram feel: one idea, maximum scale contrast, and the mark is literally cut from the type.

layouts.name: Playbill Stack Poster
layouts.recipe: Canvas 2:3, ground #000, margins 7% left/right, 6% top/bottom. Set 4-6 short uppercase lines (product names, programme titles, values), each line independently font-sized so its width = 86% of canvas width exactly (fit-to-measure), line-height 0.88, tracking 0. Alternate weights: lines 1 and 3 in a medium-weight wide grotesk, lines 2, 4, 5 in an ultra-black rounded display. The stack is top-aligned at 6%. Fill #FFFFFF, with one line in brand colour. Bottom-left: wordmark at 14% of width; bottom-right: date/URL at 1.6% of width, right-aligned on the 93% line. Pentagram feel: typography is the entire image, every line is justified to one measure like a theatre broadside.

layouts.name: Pentagram Case Sheet
layouts.recipe: Page width W, white ground, side margins 1.4%W, gutters 0.7%W. Header: project name at 3.6%W font size, sentence case, tracking -0.02em, top at 7%W; under it a one-line descriptor at 1.3%W, max width 45%W; a row of 3 grey chips (#EDEDED, text 0.8%W, radius 0.2%W); a right-aligned 'About the project +' button (#EDEDED) on the same baseline. Body sequence: (1) full-width 16:10 slide of the mark on brand ground; (2) row of two equal 50% columns: left one tall 3:4 photo, right two stacked 4:3 photos; (3) full-width 16:9 typographic slide; (4) pull quote at 1.8%W font size, x from 50%W to 98%W, with a hanging open-quote mark, 6%W vertical padding; (5) full-width signage in situ; (6) 2x2 merchandise grid with 0 gutters, each cell 1:1. No other text. Pentagram feel: a strict rhythm of full/half plates and almost no copy.

layouts.name: Radiating Initials Ring
layouts.recipe: Canvas 1:1, ground deep aubergine #1E0F1A. Centre point (50%, 50%). Draw 4 concentric circular text paths of radius 11%, 18%, 25% and 32% of width; on each, repeat the brand initials (or name) uppercase at a cap height of 3.6% of width, tracking +0.08em, the text filling the full circumference. Ring colours cycle through a three-colour set: hot pink #FF3E9A, lime #C6F432, cyan #38D6E0. Static: rotate each ring by an offset of 7deg x index. Motion: alternate rings rotate clockwise and anticlockwise at 20s per revolution ('ripple'). Bottom-left at 5% margins: full name in sans at 2.2% of width, #F2EDE6. Pentagram feel: a single generative symbol becomes the entire visual language.

name: COLLINS
philosophy: 'Rewrite your worth': COLLINS helps brands 'find and command their unique premium' by building whole worlds (illustrated universes, living typefaces) that make a future 'so irresistible, it becomes inevitable'.

faces: ABC Symphony (custom variable Arizona Serif, Dinamo) - SF Symphony
type.notes: Studio headlines in a sharp transitional serif, sentence case, ~5% of width, -0.02em tracking, light weight; UI in grotesk at 16px. Client type is elastic: letters stretch, skew or shorten progressively (crescendo), or giant rounded words wrap across packaging.

palette: Frame alternates warm near-black #140805 and off-white #F7F6F2; client palettes are saturated, ownable worlds (Robinhood green/chartreuse, up&up orange/mint, Symphony black with jewel-tone posters); orange #F05A28 marker used for process annotation.
imagery: Commissioned illustration worlds (isometric cities), lush in-situ photography (bus-shelter posters, carved stone facade signage), product macros, and process boards with hand annotations.
presentation: Hero carousel: product macro, archive photo, mark construction
Annotated presentation boards (orange marker over mockups)
signatures: Orange hand-marker annotations scrawled over clean presentation boards
Elastic type that changes its own proportions (stretch, crescendo)
One illustrated universe that carries the whole brand
Hushed near-black frame with a single serif sentence
Rounded image cards in carousels that bleed off the right edge
Results shown as giant-number stat cards

projects.what: Variable serif ABC Symphony that stretches with music; crescendo wordmark; street posters and carved facade signage; TDC Best in Show.
Illustration-led system (Ilya Milstein, Jaedoo Lee, Liam Cobb), icon set, flowing infographics, Capsule Sans + Nib.
One flexible system across 2,000+ SKUs: giant words wrapped across colour-coded packs (year approximate).

layouts.name: Annotated Presentation Board
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10, ground #F7F6F2. One application image (photo or mockup) placed at 62% of width, centred horizontally, top at 20% of height, no radius, no shadow. Overlay hand annotations in orange #F05A28: (a) 2-3 freehand SVG arrows (stroke 0.3% of width, round caps, slight wobble via 3-4 jittered control points) pointing from the margins to details in the image; (b) one rough ellipse circling a detail; (c) a 5-7 line handwritten note (handwriting font, size 1.1% of width, line-height 1.25) at top-left, x=4%, y=5%, max width 24%; (d) a 2-3 word handwritten label beside the image's top-left corner, rotated -4deg. All other space empty. COLLINS feel: process made visible, the strategist's pen on top of polished work.

layouts.name: Crescendo Serif Poster
layouts.recipe: Canvas 2:3. Top 32% = ground #EFE9DF; bottom 68% = full-bleed portrait photo (cover crop, focal point at the face). Brand name in a high-contrast transitional serif, uppercase, tracking 0, set across 90% of width at a 5% left margin, baseline at y=30%. Apply per-letter vertical scale: the first letter scaleY 2.2, each next letter decreasing linearly to scaleY 1.0 at the last (the crescendo), all letters sharing a common baseline, so the tallest letters rise to y=6%. Letters may overprint the photo edge. Bottom-left at 5% margins: 2 lines of grotesk at 1.9% of width (performer/date), white on the photo. COLLINS feel: the type behaves like the subject (music) instead of sitting still.

layouts.name: Dark Premium Statement
layouts.recipe: Viewport 16:9, ground #140805. Top bar: wordmark in uppercase sans at 0.95% of width, tracking +0.08em, #F8F8F7, at x=3.3%, y=2.2%; a two-line hamburger icon at x=96.7% on the same line. Centre: one 3-5 word sentence in a light transitional serif at 5% of width, sentence case, tracking -0.02em, centred at y=45%. At y=74%: a centred line 'Nx Agency of the Year' at 0.45% of width, and under it two rows of 4 award labels each wrapped in thin laurel brackets, at 0.45% of width, #F8F8F7 at 80%. At y=90%: the top edge of a full-colour illustration or photo card, 70% of width, centred, radius 1% of width, continuing below the fold. COLLINS feel: hush, one confident line, then a vivid world revealed below.

layouts.name: Impact Stat Cards
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9, ground #F7F6F4. Section label 'Impact' in serif at 1.7% of width, x=7%, y=10%. Row of 4 white #FFFFFF cards starting at x=7%, y=20%: each 20.5% of width x 62% of height, gap 0.8% of width, radius 0.6% of width, no shadow; the 4th card is clipped by the canvas edge (overflow) to imply a carousel. Inside each card, with 1.6% padding: a big number or arrow glyph in a light grotesk at 4.6% of width, top-left; at the bottom, a label (grotesk medium, 0.75% of width, #111) and a 4-line description (0.7% of width, #6B6B6B, line-height 1.4). COLLINS feel: premium framed as measurable proof, in a calm editorial wrapper.

name: Upstatement
philosophy: 'Brand Through Digital': a design and technology studio with journalistic roots that believes all brands are digital and systems can tell stories, so it designs the website and product system first and extends outward.

type.notes: Light high-contrast serif for display and client names (sentence case, untracked), grotesk at ~1.4% of width for body with bold for labels. Never uppercase; underlined serif client names used as a typographic list.

palette: Studio frame pure black with white type; case pages adopt the client ground (warm stone #E9E7E2, white, black) and borrow client accents (Etsy orange, Nike red).
imagery: Devices in real environments (a phone in a magenta grow-lab), campaign photography tiled into grids, frameless product cut-outs, user-journey diagrams, award badges.
presentation: Editorial opener (title, deck, What We Did / What We Made, hero)
signatures: Light serif + grotesk pairing, untracked, all sentence case
Mixed-size floating collage on black with dot markers
'What We Did / What We Made' twin-list metadata
UI shown inside real physical places
Bird's-eye overview of the entire toolkit as proof
Underlined serif names as a list

projects.what: Early mainstream responsive news website; the studio's editorial-digital origin.
MIT.edu homepage with fragmented 'MIT' bars that assemble, plus smart search (year approximate).
'Keep Commerce Human' product brand toolkit built on a square metaphor across buyer app and web (year approximate).

layouts.name: Floating Collage on Black
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10, ground #000. Use a 12-column invisible grid with 4% margins. Place 6 images of deliberately mismatched sizes with no shared edges or baselines: A 28% wide 3:4 at (x 6%, y 8%); B 9% wide 4:5 at (x 44%, y 4%); C 18% wide 1:1 at (x 58%, y 30%); D 11% wide 3:4 frameless product cut-out at (x 38%, y 52%); E 22% wide 4:5 at (x 72%, y 56%); F 7% wide 1:1 at (x 18%, y 70%). Scatter 12-16 white dots (diameter 0.25% of width) in two loose 3x2 clusters in empty space. One 3-line caption in grotesk at 0.85% of width, #FFF, max width 26%, at (x 40%, y 34%). No headline. Upstatement feel: an art-directed magazine spread translated to scroll.

layouts.name: Editorial Case Opener
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10, ground warm stone #E9E7E2, text #111. Left column x 4% to 34%: client name in a light serif at 3% of width, sentence case, top at y=9% (two lines allowed); a bold grotesk deck at 0.9% of width, y=24%; a hairline (1px) rule across the column at y=27%; body grotesk at 0.75% of width, line-height 1.45, 8-10 lines; at y=50% two side-by-side lists 'What We Did' / 'What We Made' (labels bold, items regular, 0.75% of width, 1.6 line-height). Right: hero photo x 50% to 96%, top y=11%, aspect 4:3 (person using the product). Below the fold: a centred paragraph x 30% to 70% at 0.85% of width. Upstatement feel: a newspaper feature layout for a brand.

layouts.name: Headline with Floating Screens
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9, ground #FFFFFF. Headline: 3 words on 3 lines in a light serif, cap height 15% of height, line-height 0.95, tracking -0.02em, left at x=8%, top at y=12%, #2B1B2E. Five phone screens (aspect 9:19.5, width 10% of canvas, radius 1.4% of width, 0.4% black bezel, soft shadow 0 2% 4% rgba(0,0,0,.12)) at x = 4%, 33%, 47%, 61%, 84% with y offsets of 28%, 6%, 34%, 10%, 30%, deliberately overlapping the headline letters. Add 6-8 small brand-colour UI chips (pills 4% x 2%, brand accent) and two tiny product cut-outs floating between the phones. Upstatement feel: brand voice and product UI collapsed into one editorial composition.

layouts.name: UI in the Wild
layouts.recipe: Canvas 4:5, full-bleed environment photo with saturated light (cover crop). A single black phone frame, width 30% of canvas, centred at (50%, 46%), showing the product UI (search field plus results; primary button in the brand colour). Caption in grotesk at 2% of width, #FFF, 3 lines, at x=66%, y=64%, max width 28%. Small studio/brand mark bottom-left at 4% margins. No overlay or gradient. Upstatement feel: digital product as a real object in a real place.

name: DIA
philosophy: A 'design, research and innovation studio' building 'kinetic identity systems, typographic systems, and generative tools': identity is behaviour and time is the material, so the logo is a system in motion, not a static lockup.

faces: Custom sans + serif with Francois Rappo (Flodesk)
Geometric/grotesk caps pushed through code (Adidas, Chaumont)
type.notes: Studio voice is a quiet old-style serif at 16px in black and 50% grey. Client type is uppercase grotesk treated as material: rotated 90 degrees into columns, repeated as walls, letter widths modulated by wave functions, glyphs swapped for image mosaics, type wrapped on 3D surfaces.

palette: Mostly monochrome (white on black, black on white) with one accent per project: meme-mosaic colour for Chaumont, warm orange and navy for Flodesk, pale mint #DFF7EE with forest green #0B2B1E for Cohere North.
imagery: Motion stills and loops (LED walls, window type, generative contour fields, distorted UI); documentary photos of posters on French street furniture, totes on people, book spreads on concrete.
presentation: Kinetic type on retail/LED walls or screens
Posters in situ on street furniture
signatures: Wordmark as a time-based behaviour, not a lockup
Letters rotated 90 degrees into vertical columns repeated as a wall
Elastic letter widths following a wave function
Characters replaced by image/meme mosaics
Generative line fields (contours, Voronoi) as brand texture
Type mapped onto architecture in video
Uniform equal-size thumbnail grids for documentation

projects.what: Generative content system (with FIELD) so visuals never repeat during a visit; LED walls, window type, storefront.
Custom tool generating kinetic type from memes; posters, tote, pins, catalogue.
Full rebrand with custom typeface (Optimo), motion system and product integration; packaging, caps, billboards.

layouts.name: Rotated Column Type Wall
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9, ground #000. Divide the width into 8 equal columns with 2.5% gutters and 4% outer margins (column width ~9.2%). In each column set one brand word in uppercase geometric grotesk rotated 90deg (odd columns) or -90deg (even columns), cap height = column width, repeated end-to-end so it overflows top and bottom (cropped by the canvas edges). Columns 3 and 6 use outline (0.15% stroke) instead of fill. Fill #FFF. Static frame: offset each column vertically by (index x 13% of height) mod the word length. Motion: each column scrolls vertically at speeds 20-60px/s, alternating direction. No other elements. DIA feel: the wordmark becomes a rhythmic, time-based pattern.

layouts.name: Elastic Grotesk Poster
layouts.recipe: Canvas 2:3, ground #FFF, margins 4%. Title in 4-5 uppercase lines of a neutral grotesk, each line fitted to 92% of width. Per letter, set horizontal scale = 1 + 0.8*sin(i*0.9 + line*1.3) clamped to 0.45-2.1, then re-fit the line to the measure; line-height 0.86. Replace 3-5 random letters with rectangles of the same advance width and cap height filled with a pixelated photo crop (12px mosaic). Bottom-left: date in the same grotesk, two lines, cap height 7% of width, tight; bottom-right: 6-line info block at 1.3% of width. Black only, plus the image tiles. DIA feel: type generated by a system, curated by a human.

layouts.name: Archive Grid Case Page
layouts.recipe: Page width W, ground #FFF. Top bar at y=1%W: 'STUDIO:' in black + project name in #8A8A8A, old-style serif at 1.1%W, x=0.8%W; right side '[ Next ][ Close ]' in the same serif. Grid: 4 equal columns, outer margin 0.8%W, gutter 0.4%W, tile aspect 16:10, 5-6 rows, every tile identical size. Order the tiles: motion stills, in-situ posters, flat spreads, macro details, merch on people. Under the grid, after a 1.2%W gap, a text band: left half (0.8%W to 49%W) description in serif at 1%W, line-height 1.25; right half: grey label 'Credits:' at 50%W with names at 55%W in a stacked list, then 'Year:'. DIA feel: an archive where motion and print get equal weight.

layouts.name: Contour Field Brand Card
layouts.recipe: Canvas 1:1, ground pale mint #DFF7EE. Generate 14-20 closed contour lines from 2D Perlin noise (scale 0.004, thresholds evenly spaced), stroke #0B2B1E at 0.15% of width, no fill, covering the full canvas. Centred wordmark at 34% of width in #0B2B1E on a mint knockout rectangle (padding 2% of width, same colour as the ground) so the lines stop around it. Motion: advance the noise z-offset slowly (morphing terrain). Bottom-left micro-label in monospace at 1% of width. DIA feel: generative texture as identity, with calm typography on top.

name: Marx Design
philosophy: An independent brand and packaging agency for Australia and New Zealand that researches a brand's origin, names a single idea (e.g. 'premium abstraction') and executes it with in-house packaging form, copywriting and photography art direction.

faces: Die Grotesk B Medium - studio site
type.notes: Studio uses one grotesk medium at 19px body, ~38px intro; case titles ~4% of width with a trailing comma. Client headlines are short ragged lines with unexpected indents carrying playful copy; heritage work uses widely spaced Roman capitals, debossed or foiled.

palette: Per-project colour worlds that also recolour the page: cream with lemon/sky/orange/red blobs (StrangeLove), deep olive #5B5420 + black + gold foil (Hunter's), strict black/off-white (Autex), cobalt (Liquor Lickers).
imagery: Hard-lit studio still life, bottles laid diagonally over cut paper shapes, faces hidden by flavour shapes, hands entering frame, heritage archive photography, deboss and foil macros (photographer Yuki Sato).
presentation: Poster series in situ on concrete
Single pack hero on colour blob
signatures: Huge project name with a trailing comma, fixed top-left
Organic flavour blob behind a cut-out product
Ragged short-line headlines with odd indents
Product-derived pattern (tapered slats)
Tonal deboss: wordmark visible only via shadow
Page background recolours per project
Staggered asymmetric image flow with big gaps

projects.what: 'Premium abstraction': flavour blobs, dot pattern, irreverent copy; sales doubled after launch.
Clan crest redrawn as an oval, Celtic-nuanced wordmark, MiruMiru sparkling in olive and gold (year approximate).
Customer-facing acoustic brand: black and white, patterns derived from acoustic panels; guidelines, stationery, digital.

layouts.name: Comma-Title Case Page
layouts.recipe: Page width W; ground = project tone (#FFF or #000), text the inverse. Fixed title top-left at x=0.9%W, y=0.6%W: project name + ',' in grotesk medium at 4%W, tracking -0.02em. Hero: two images side by side, x 6.5%-50% and 51.7%-95.5%, top at 17%W (or one image 6.5%-95.5%). Text block at y=hero bottom + 10%W: services list at x 6.5%W (0.75%W, grey #9A9A9A, 1.3 line-height); headline at x 44%W (1.3%W); body in two columns 44-68%W and 70-95%W at 0.6%W. Then a staggered flow with 12%W vertical gaps: right-shifted image 26-94.5%W; full 5-94.5%W; half 5-49%W with half 51-94.5%W offset 8%W lower; repeat. Marx feel: gallery pacing, asymmetric and confident, the page wears the brand colour.

layouts.name: Premium Abstraction Pack Poster
layouts.recipe: Canvas 3:4, ground cream #F3EFE6. Organic blob (an 8-point closed spline with random radius 0.8-1.2) 44% of width, flavour colour (#F5D21E / #9EC6F0 / #F28C3A / #E2231A), centred at (46%, 48%). Product cut-out photo laid diagonally (rotate -62deg), 70% of width long, crossing the blob. Headline in clean grotesk medium at 4.4% of width, 6-8 short lines of 1-3 words, ragged, starting x=52%, y=38%, with per-line indents of 0%, -6%, 4%, 0%, -3%; colour #111. Logo top-right at 9% of width, 5% margins; 4-line micro body bottom-left at 1.1% of width; stacked number '45' + unit at left edge at 2.6% of width, y=40%. Marx feel: modernist abstraction plus cheeky copy around a beautifully lit product.

layouts.name: Tonal Heritage Deboss
layouts.recipe: Canvas 4:3, ground deep olive #5B5420 with subtle paper noise (3% opacity). Crest/monogram at 10% of width, centred at (50%, 22%), filled with a gold foil gradient (#C9A35A to #8C6A2E to #E5C27A, 135deg) plus a 0.2% highlight stroke. Wordmark: high-contrast Roman caps, tracking +0.02em, spanning 92% of width, cap height 19% of height, baseline at y=88%; fill = ground colour with inner shadow (0 0.25% 0.4% rgba(0,0,0,.45)) and a 1px top highlight rgba(255,255,255,.12), so it reads only as a blind deboss. Optional tagline in small tracked caps (+0.2em) at 1.2% of width, centred at y=60%, #CFC6A0. Marx feel: heritage refined into quiet, tactile luxury.

layouts.name: Product-Pattern Panel
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10, ground #000. Inset panel #1C1C1C at x 30%-96%, y 14%-86%. Inside it, 11 tapered vertical slats (quadrilaterals) in off-white #F2F0EA: heights 80% of the panel, widths varying 1.6-5.5% of canvas, each skewed 6-14deg, gaps 1.2-2.8%, giving a rhythmic fan. Small logo bottom-left of the panel at 3% of width; at x=4%, y=60% a 3-line headline in grotesk at 2% of width, #F2F0EA ('Find / inner / peace'). Marx feel: the product's physical form becomes the brand pattern, strictly monochrome.

name: Inhouse
philosophy: Thirty years of craft-led work rooted in Aotearoa (books, wine, art, public services, hospitality), presented as a quiet archive of artefacts with five plain facts each rather than case-study rhetoric.

type.notes: Studio voice is one Helvetica size (~1.2% of width), regular, sentence case, +0.015em tracking, even for captions and nav. Client marks are geometric constructions (squares, chevrons, arrows, letters in boxes); book typography is classical; artist lettering is commissioned for campaigns.

palette: Neutral and material (white, black, kraft, concrete); colour arrives as one strong field: NZ Post red/navy, NZIFF deep red or blue gradients, Grava orange dots, Steinlager red.
imagery: Moody in-situ photography (pictograms on raw concrete, livery on trucks, totes in hotel lobbies), product still life on plinths, overhead book spreads, studio incidentals; greyscale contact sheets.
presentation: Each as a separate captioned fragment
signatures: One artefact per screen in vast white space
Five-field factual captions (name, client, discipline, sector, year) instead of prose
Marks built from squares/windows scattered like a constellation
Thin gold line pictograms on black square signs
Large diagonal light-ray gradients for festival posters
Greyscale contact-sheet index

projects.what: Mark from an array of squares based on the facade's windows; wayfinding, posters, tote; Best Awards Gold Pins.
Master logo, bold red chevron truck livery, brand photography.
O-S-S-A letter-in-square logo set that rearranges; tissue paper and packaging (2022-23).

layouts.name: Single Fragment Gallery
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9, ground #FFF. Navigation: 7 labels in Helvetica regular at 1.2% of width, spread with equal spacing (justify-between) across x 2.5%-97.5% at y=2.5%, active item underlined. Content: one image only, width 18% of canvas (portrait 3:4 or landscape 4:3), vertically centred, horizontal position chosen from {12%, 41%, 70%} per slide; behind it 1-2 sibling images of the same project at the same size offset by (-1.8%, +2%) and (+1.5%, -1.5%), no shadows or borders. No caption on the canvas. Inhouse feel: museum quiet, the artefact alone in white.

layouts.name: Index Table
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9, ground #FFF, text #000 Helvetica regular at 1.05% of width. Top 42% empty except the nav (as in the gallery). From y=42% downward, a table of rows 2% of height apart with a 1px #000 rule above each row, spanning x 2.5%-97.5%. Columns: Name at x 2.5%, Client at 35%, Discipline at 53%, Sector at 70%, Year right-aligned at 97.5%. 25-28 rows, cropped at the bottom edge. Inhouse feel: the work as a catalogue, facts over adjectives.

layouts.name: Lightbox with Caption Strip
layouts.recipe: Canvas 4:3, ground #FFF. Image (cover crop) from x 2.5% to 97.5% and y 8.5% to 91.5%. 'Close' centred at y=2.2%, Helvetica at 1.2% of width. 'Prev' rotated -90deg at x=1.2%, centred vertically; 'Next' rotated 90deg at x=98.8%. Caption row baseline at y=96.5%: five fields at the same x-stops as the index (2.5%, 35%, 53%, 70%, right-aligned 97.5%), 1.2% of width. Nothing else. Inhouse feel: archival restraint, the in-situ photo does all the talking.

layouts.name: Window-Constellation Tote
layouts.recipe: Canvas 4:5 photo of a natural canvas tote (or a kraft bag) carried in a dim interior. On the bag face: a constellation of 7 off-white #F4F1EA squares in three sizes (5%, 3.5% and 2.2% of canvas width) scattered within a box of 34% x 30% centred at (52%, 64%), no two squares touching, irregular like lit windows on a facade. No wordmark on the bag. Companion signage: black squares at 9% of width with thin gold #C8A96A line pictograms (stroke 0.35% of width) mounted on raw concrete. Inhouse feel: architecture-derived abstraction applied with craft restraint.

name: Studio Nari
philosophy: Caterina Bianchini's studio bridges design and art with a 'humanistic, artistic approach', treating bespoke typography as the core of every brand and hiding playful details for people to discover.

faces: Liquid ligatured serif/script wordmarks (Nike LA Legacy)
Modular monoline wordmark system (3TEMP, existing logo extended)
type.notes: Ultra-condensed black display caps filling the full width, tight leading 0.85-0.9, letters swapped for solid dots or circles; alternatively chrome-rendered liquid serif ligatures. Type anchors the top or bottom edge 'like furniture'.

palette: One hot accent against warm neutrals (Mensah orange #FF8C3A on stone grey #E6E6E4; 3TEMP terracotta #B8653F, brown, deep red #6E1414, mint flash); campaign work fully saturated (red #E8341C, cobalt #1C3FD1, ultraviolet).
imagery: Sculptural product photography on plinths, wheat-paste posters and billboards in London streets, chrome/3D type renders, sticker-bomb collage, embossed leather/metal/paper macros.
signatures: A bespoke display typeface per brand
Letters replaced by dots or circles inside headlines
Headline as a full-width band at the top, object floating below
Liquid/ligatured wordmarks rendered in chrome
One hot colour against stone grey
Modular logo construction driving the layout grid
Monogram as embossed object (key fob, spoon, ice cube)

projects.what: Custom 'Modular' typeface and slotted MBM monogram; posters, tote, social, shipping container.
Ten-month rebrand dropping 'Kitchen': flexible Right Grotesk system with sticker/illustration energy.
Existing modular wordmark extended into a layout system: embossing, packaging, trade-show booth, signage, merch.

layouts.name: Type-as-Furniture Poster
layouts.recipe: Canvas 4:5, ground stone grey #E6E6E4. Headline: one word, uppercase, ultra-condensed black display, fitted to 92% of width at 4% margins, top at 3%, cap height about 17% of height, line-height 0.85; replace one letter (an O or the last letter's counter) with a solid black circle of cap-height diameter. Product photo (object on a plinth, soft daylight) 42% of width x 52% of height, centred, top at 28%. Bottom: a single caption line in the same display at 2.4% of width, centred at y=94%. No other elements. Nari feel: the type dresses the page like furniture dresses a room.

layouts.name: Orange Manifesto Split
layouts.recipe: Canvas 2:1. Left half: solid #FF8C3A with 7 lines of ultra-condensed black caps, left-aligned at x=3%, top 4%, cap height 11% of height, line-height 0.92; word spaces and some letters replaced by solid dots (cap-height x 0.45 circles); one line ends with a colon made of two dots. Right half: #E6E6E4 with the brand monogram in black at 42% of half-width, centred. A 0.3% white gutter between halves. Nari feel: a manifesto in custom type beside a sculptural mark.

layouts.name: Liquid Ligature Wordmark
layouts.recipe: Canvas 3:4, ground saturated (#E8341C or #1C3FD1) with 4% film-grain noise. Wordmark: one word in a high-contrast serif or script with exaggerated swash ligatures (connected ascenders/descenders), width 82% of canvas, centred at y=44%, slight -6deg baseline tilt; render as a chrome or gold gradient (#F7E2A1 to #C7891E to #FFF3C4) with a 0.8% offset drop-extrusion in a darker tone. Bottom: a centred credit line in small uppercase grotesk at 1.1% of width, tracking +0.08em, accent colour, reading 'STUDIO X CLIENT PRESENTS', with the project name under it. Nari feel: art-led lettering as the hero, campaign-grade colour.

layouts.name: Modular-Line Packaging Sheet
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:10 product-sheet grid of 2x2 cells, gap 0.6%. Cell A: terracotta #B8653F ground with the wordmark constructed from monoline modular strokes (stroke 2% of width, square caps, right-angle turns only), 70% of cell width, centred. Cell B: an aluminium box photo with a vertical version of the wordmark running up the side. Cell C: deep red #6E1414 with a blind-debossed tagline in stencil grotesk at 6% of cell width. Cell D: a leather key fob or metal spoon macro with an embossed icon. Nari feel: one modular logic carried through embossing, material and layout.

name: Regular Practice
philosophy: A 'playful yet carefully considered' studio, 'sector-agnostic by choice, category-defining by practice', that believes 'fresh satisfies' and 'details compound', moving creatively ambitious clients into forward-thinking market positions.

faces: Tight black grotesk stacked monogram (Future Snoops)
type.notes: Studio voice: light sans in sentence case for one-line taglines (~2% of width), tiny 12px labels. Client type is commercial and bold, often uppercase on physical material (tape, signs) or compressed into stacked monograms.

palette: One saturated brand colour per client applied as physical material: Purplebricks purple #7A1196, Future Snoops acid chartreuse #D9DD10, Form brick red #9A2A0C; studio frame off-white #FAFAFA.
imagery: Mostly motion; tight physical macros (tape on boxes, stamped blades, knife in lemons), signage in real streets, hands with print, silhouetted products on dark gradients, 3D product renders.
signatures: Brand colour as material (tape, boards, stamped steel)
50/50 macro pairs: object vs colour
Huge white gaps between image groups
Taglines replace project titles
Rounded portrait video cards with inset caption and VIEW pill
Stamped/embossed monograms in hexagons or lozenges

projects.what: 'Own it' / 'No Bull' relaunch: Oatmeal type, house-shaped boards, purple tape, welcome pack.
Cookware 'designed in London, forged in Sheffield': foundry-stamp monogram on blades and red boxes.
Trend agency identity: stacked FS monogram on acid yellow, digital-first platform.

layouts.name: Bottom-Sheet Case Page
layouts.recipe: Viewport 16:10. Background: the previous page scaled to 96% and dimmed (#000 at 35%). Foreground sheet: #FAFAFA, x 0.7%-99.3%, top at 1.5% of height, top corners radius 1% of width. Drag handle: pill 8% x 0.5% of width, #E3E3E3, centred at 0.7% from the sheet top. Title: one-line tagline in a light sans at 1.6% of width, centred, 2.8% from the sheet top. Content flow (full sheet width, no side margins): 4:3 full-bleed hero; then 25% of viewport height of empty #FAFAFA; then a 50/50 pair (gutter 0.4% of width) of 4:5 images; gap again; a full-bleed 16:9 in-situ shot; gap; a 50/50 print pair. Regular Practice feel: app-like sheet, editorial silence between bold frames.

layouts.name: Brand Tape Macro
layouts.recipe: Canvas 4:5, full-bleed macro photo of a kraft cardboard box edge (warm side light). Brand-colour tape strip (#7A1196) running vertically at x 78%-94% from top to bottom, folding over the box edge at y=58% (a darker 12% band across the fold). Inside the tape: the wordmark in a bold rounded sans, uppercase, rotated 90deg, white, letter height 9% of width, repeating along the strip with a 4% gap. Optional prop: a single yellow object (pen, cutter) diagonal at the fold. Regular Practice feel: the brand colour is a physical material in a real moment.

layouts.name: Portrait Video Card Hero
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9, ground #FFF. Main card: 38% of width x 92% of height (portrait), x=2%, y=4%, radius 0.8% of width, full-bleed product macro on a saturated ground (e.g. a stamped steel blade on brick red #9A2A0C). Inset at the card's top-left (padding 0.6%): thumbnail 4% x 6.5%, beside it a 3-line caption (tagline in white, then 2 lines in brand-tint) at 0.55% of width, and under the thumbnail a white 'VIEW' pill 4% x 1.2%, text 0.45%. Two following cards peek at x 41% and 80% (cropped by the edge). Right column x 42%-98%: headline 'New ideas. New approaches.' 2 lines at 2.1% of width, light sans, top 4%. Regular Practice feel: motion-first, product-close, calm UI wrapper.

layouts.name: House-Shape Board
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9 in-situ photo of a brick terraced street with front-garden planting. Sign panel = house silhouette (rectangle with a pitched roof and a notch for a chimney: pentagon plus a small square) in brand purple #7A1196 with a 0.6% white keyline, width 9% of canvas, centred at (69%, 42%), on a purple post down to y=100%. Copy inside: 'Own it.' in white sans at 1.5% of width, then the wordmark stacked on 2 lines, uppercase, bold rounded sans, cap height 2.6% of width, lilac #C9A6F5. Regular Practice feel: confident everyday-category branding set in a real street.

name: Monday Nights
philosophy: A digital-first brand studio for sports, tech and culture (founded 2023 by Matt Caldwell and Dan Allan) combining graphic, motion, 3D and type design to 'make world-class design accessible' through 'raw invention'.

faces: Sculptural serif wordmark + wide-tracked serif caps (Bolder)
Condensed cut sports caps (World Snooker Tour)
Ultra-condensed black + condensed italic serif (Red Bull Review)
type.notes: Mixes refined serifs tracked +0.12em at small sizes with aggressive condensed display for sport; vertical (rotated) mastheads; construction views with coordinate labels are part of the type story.

palette: Stripped-back neutrals (warm grey #E4E2DE, near-black #111) with one electric accent per brand: Bolder lime #E1FF2E, WST red #E8102A, Echospace coral/cobalt; Red Bull Review cool blue-grey studio light.
imagery: Heavy 3D (looping extruded initials, logo as physical object, hard hats, gilets), cut-out athletes inside brand-shape frames, editorial studio shoots of athletes using printed matter, construction drawings with coordinates.
signatures: Logo as a looping 3D object; static mark is an off-axis frame
Visible grids, crop marks and corner dots kept in final artwork
Single neon accent as a highlight bar behind text
Construction plates with coordinate labels
Brand shape as a crop frame around cut-out people
Strict 16:9 / 8:9 plate pairs

projects.what: Endlessly rotating sculpted 'B', sculptural wordmark, lime accent and the visible 'Bolder Grid'.
Triangle-rack symbol, event lockup hierarchy, posters, app, broadcast graphics, kit.
Printed year-in-review: vertical condensed masthead, shot in use by athletes in a blue-grey studio.

layouts.name: Off-Axis 3D Initial Reveal
layouts.recipe: Canvas 16:9, ground radial gradient #2A2A2A (centre) to #0B0B0B (edges). The brand initial extruded in 3D (depth 22% of glyph height, bevel 2%), glyph height 46% of canvas height, centred, rotated Y 24deg and X -8deg so it reads slightly off-axis; material off-white satin, one face edge lit with the accent lime #E1FF2E (rim light). Bottom-right: label 'WORDMARK' in serif caps at 0.75% of width, tracking +0.14em, followed by a 0.6% solid square, at 3% margins. Top-left: a 0.5% outline square marker at 2%/2%. Motion: continuous Y rotation, 8s loop. Monday Nights feel: logo as a crafted object, with motion-first thinking.

layouts.name: Visible Grid Social Tile
layouts.recipe: Canvas 4:5, ground #161616. Guide lines: 1px rgba(255,255,255,.18) at x=14% and x=86% and y=12% and y=88%, running edge to edge, with small 0.6% crosshair ticks at the four intersections. Inside the guide box: a 2-column x 3-row grid of square tiles with 0 gutters: (1,1) white tile with the logo lockup centred at 40% of tile width; (2,1) solid lime #E1FF2E; (1,2) and (2,3) 3D renders; (2,2) white tile with a 3-line widely tracked serif caps text at 1.1% of width (+0.3em); (1,3) dark render. A small circular logo badge at the top-left guide intersection. Bottom: like/comment glyphs at 1.5% if mocking a feed. Monday Nights feel: the construction grid is left in as part of the brand.

layouts.name: Shape-Framed Athlete Poster
layouts.recipe: Canvas 2:3, ground cream #F7F3E8. Large rounded-triangle outline (corner radius 18% of side), stroke 3% of width, brand red #E8102A, side length 95% of width, centred at (55%, 62%), partially cropped by the right edge. 2-3 cut-out athletes (photo, no background) overlapping the triangle, tallest figure 70% of height, feet cropped at the bottom; the front figure sits above the stroke, the others behind it (interleave). Top-left at 5% margins: date block in condensed sans, 3 lines '06-09 / DEC / 2024', cap height 4.5% of width, with the year in outline (0.25% stroke). Bottom-left: event lockup (symbol + two-line name) at 22% of width. A diagonal red shard enters from the bottom-right corner (15% of width). Monday Nights feel: sport energy through brand-shape framing and condensed type.

layouts.name: 16:9 / 8:9 Plate Sequence
layouts.recipe: Page width W, ground #0F0F0F, outer margin 2%W, gutter 1%W. Plates are only two sizes: full plates 96%W x 54%W (16:9) and half plates 47.5%W x 53.4%W (8:9), paired in rows so each row is 16:9 overall. Sequence: (1) full: logo reveal on black; (2) full: wordmark construction with outline letters, 1px guides and 0.5%W coordinate labels; (3) half + half: 3D symbol render / lockup with guides on warm grey #E4E2DE; (4) full: three OOH digital boards in a dark station; (5) full: three phones of social; (6) half + half: social post / deck quote slide; (7) full: type specimen (large 'Aa' plus alphabet); (8) full: website scroll; (9) half + half: tee on model / tote; (10) full: brand line in widely tracked caps across the centre. Monday Nights feel: a broadcast-ready, motion-led reel, rigorously modular.
